title: Quantum-Inspired Hamiltonian Optimization, Stochastic Tensor Networks and Adaptive Congestion Routing for Large-Scale QKD Networks
summary: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) networks require routing methodologies capable of jointly optimizing latency, secret key generation rate, congestion, finite capacity and operational security constraints under dynamically evolving traffic conditions. In this work we introduce a quantum-inspired optimization framework for adaptive multi-demand routing in QKD communication networks based on effective Hamiltonian modelling, Quantum Monte Carlo inspired annealing and stochastic Tensor-Network State (TNS) compression.
